shorts.title: The Arctic Tern Holds a Record No Animal Can Beat 🌍
shorts.description:
This bird holds a record nobody can beat. Arctic terns attack people who get near their nests, usually striking the top or back of the head.

#shorts #animalfacts #meatballmyths

Photos (iNaturalist), cropped and color-adjusted: Arctic tern: Blake Ross (CC BY), tcantrell52 (CC BY), Paolo Zucca (CC BY), brendanboyd (CC BY). creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0 · creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0
shorts.comment: What did you guess the record was?

shorts.title: A Red Kangaroo Can Jump 9 Meters in One Hop 🦘
shorts.description:
A red kangaroo can jump nine meters. A mother can nurse a joey at her feet and a tiny one in the pouch at the same time, from different teats.

#shorts #animalfacts #meatballmyths

Photos (iNaturalist), cropped and color-adjusted: Red kangaroo: avocat (CC BY), dhfischer (CC BY), CC0. creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0 · creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0

shorts.title: The Laughing Kookaburra Will Steal Your Sausage 🌭
shorts.description:
This bird laughs, then steals your food. Grown kids often stay home and help their parents raise the next chicks.

#shorts #animalfacts #meatballmyths

Photos (iNaturalist), cropped and color-adjusted: Laughing kookaburra: Jan Ebr & Ivana Ebrová (CC BY), CC0. creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0 · creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0
shorts.comment: Has a bird ever stolen your food?

shorts.title: Baby Wood Ducks Jump From Trees on Day Two 🦆
shorts.description:
This duck nests up in trees. Nest boxes put up from the 1930s helped wood ducks recover.

#shorts #animalfacts #meatballmyths

Photos (iNaturalist), cropped and color-adjusted: Wood duck: Adrienne van den Beemt (CC BY), Andrew Lai (CC BY), James M. Maley (CC BY), Wendy McCrady (CC BY). creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0 · creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0
shorts.comment: Would you jump on your second day alive?

shorts.title: A Cheetah Can Go 0-60 in Under 3 Seconds 🐆
shorts.description:
Cheetahs hit sixty in under three seconds. Cheetahs chirp and purr; their purr is like a house cat's but much louder.

#shorts #animalfacts #meatballmyths

Photos (iNaturalist), cropped and color-adjusted: Cheetah: Morten Ross (CC BY), Dirk Froebel (CC BY), Karim Haddad (CC BY). creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0 · creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0

shorts.title: A Bighorn Ram's Horns Weigh as Much as All His Bones 🐏
shorts.description:
These horns weigh as much as his bones. Bighorns climb steep cliffs to get away from predators.

#shorts #animalfacts #meatballmyths

Photos (iNaturalist), cropped and color-adjusted: Bighorn sheep: John Krampl (CC BY), Marilynn Miller (CC BY). creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0 · creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0
shorts.comment: Who wins: you or the ram?

shorts.title: Snapping Turtles Go Six Months Without Breathing 🐢
shorts.description:
This turtle can skip breathing six months. On land they're feisty, but in water they usually flee and hide in the mud.

#shorts #animalfacts #meatballmyths

Photos (iNaturalist), cropped and color-adjusted: Common snapping turtle: Siddarth Machado (CC BY), Anne Parker (CC BY), CC0. creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0 · creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0
shorts.comment: Could you hold your breath that long?

shorts.title: This Bird Can Learn 200 Songs, Including Car Alarms 🎶
shorts.description:
This bird can learn two hundred songs. Mockingbirds are the state bird of Arkansas, Florida, Mississippi, Tennessee and Texas.

#shorts #animalfacts #meatballmyths

Photos (iNaturalist), cropped and color-adjusted: Northern mockingbird: hr_dragonfly (CC BY), CC0. creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0 · creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0
shorts.comment: Ever been fooled by a bird?

shorts.title: Bald Eagles Steal Fish From Other Birds 🦅
shorts.description:
Bald eagles steal fish from other birds. Their real call is a weak, chirpy whistle.

#shorts #animalfacts #meatballmyths

Photos (iNaturalist), cropped and color-adjusted: Bald eagle: Matt Felperin (CC BY), Luciano Massa (CC BY). creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0 · creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0
shorts.comment: Did you know the national bird steals lunch?
